verdict.rationale: HyperAgent, Hyperbrowser's open-source framework, extends Playwright with AI so developers can write natural-language commands instead of selectors, for example `page.ai("search for flights... select the cheapest option")`. That covers the core of driving the page through described actions rather than brittle selectors. Missing for 10: documented granular per-element primitives (act/click/type on a described element, as distinct from task-level page.ai), explicit evidence of resilience to selector and layout changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
